Analysis: While both hypotheses propose innovative applications of exosomal miRNA profiling in HCC, Hypothesis 2 is superior in terms of plausibility and testability. It builds on well-known pathways (HGF/MET and angiogenesis) that are extensively studied in HCC, making the proposed biomarker panel easier to validate with existing methods. Although both hypotheses face challenges regarding candidate specificity and mechanistic details, Hypothesis 2’s focus on discrete molecular pathways provides a clearer framework for experimental design and clinical validation. Safety concerns are minimal for both, but the more targeted approach in Hypothesis 2 gives it an edge in parameter control and translational potential.
